page.layout: One page of text in one column. Running head at top, with page number at top right. Below the text: signature "Dd 2" at centre-left foot, catchword "Bibli-" at right. No margin notes.

main_text.p: Hebraicæ supellectile enarrari & in omnem partem versari, hacq; dissertatio-ne Achilleum hæreticorum argumentum contra vulgatam penitus convelli; alia insuper ratio ex Priore consequens eos ad id suadendum non parum commove-bat; inde enim consequitur, hoc semel dato, nihil plane certum esse posse, cum Ec-clesiæ authoritati nihil prorsus deferunt; nam si tam multis scatet mendis id, quod est solum eorum fidei columen, fidem eo-rum necesse est esse caducam ad modum & prorsus ficulneam; hoc consequens op-posuerunt Capello sui & varie animum versat & in omnes partes torquet, ut ei re-spondeat, ut videre est pag. 12. p. 186. & præsertim pag. 387 sect. 5, 6. & aliis locis, sed semper incassum fumumque fugiens in ignem incidit; faverunt huius libri editioni viri docti complures, quos intererant viri celebres Dionysius Petavius & Marinus Mercennus è minimorum familia, à quorum sententia nec ego alienus eram; hurū testimoniis adiutus Capellus & Bibliopolam invenit & privilegium in

page.notes: Page number printed as "6o" (the o may be a zero): read as 60 [?]. Printed "dato" at the line break "da / to" shows no clear hyphen; written without one. "dissertatio-" hyphen is printed. Italic on "pag. 12. p. 186. & præsertim pag. 387 sect. 5, 6." is visually set apart and marked <i>. "hurū" has a macron as printed. Two occurrences of "in" and "&" join words loosely on the scan (e.g. "neAchilleum", "vulgatam"); spacing normalised. "versat&c" and "torqvet" printed with v; normalised u, "fumumqve" and "qvos" normalised to "que" and "quos" per the u/v rule.
